entities.name: Zygmunt Łoziński
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zygmunt Łoziński was a Polish Roman Catholic bishop who served as the Bishop of Minsk (1917–1925) and later as the first Bishop of Pinsk. Soviet authorities arrested him on two occasions during his episcopate.
